description: Utility object providing a string splitting function that returns a custom LinkedList of tokens split by spaces.

classes.name: SplitUtils
classes.description: Object containing utility methods for splitting strings into tokens.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits the input string into tokens separated by spaces and returns a LinkedList of the tokens.

methods.name: addIfValid
methods.description: Adds a token to the list if it passes validity checks.

methods.name: isTokenValid
methods.description: Checks whether a token is non-empty.
